name: experiment-ledger
description: /experiments [idea]: reads the experiment ledger ~/Trading/_ledger/experiments.jsonl that write_verdict() appends to (policy rule experiment_ledger). No argument: row and verdict counts, the 15 newest rows (pf, t, p, basis, null, verdict, blocked rules) and the top 10 ideas. With an idea: its rows (newest 50), its latest verdict and whether kill-ledger treats it as killed (latest FAIL). Malformed lines are skipped and counted.
